bead.title: Enforce routing eligibility before scoring
bead.description: Make the routing boundary explicit in code: hard pins and capability/context/power constraints determine eligibility before any cost, utilization, performance, or sticky scoring is applied. This complements the existing harness-pin work rather than replacing it.
bead.acceptance:
1. Harness, provider/source/endpoint, and model pins filter candidates before scoring and never broaden to another value.
2. Profile/MinPower/MaxPower filter only unpinned automatic routing and never override hard pins.
3. Rejected candidates carry machine-readable FilterReason values for the first eligibility failure.
4. Statement-backed routing tests cover hard pins, power bounds, exact-pin-only models, and no-candidate evidence.
5. go test ./internal/routing ./internal/serviceimpl ./... -run "Eligibility|HardPin|NoCandidate|FilterReason" passes.
